q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a door hinge?
title: Door hinge carbon footprint per hinge
short: Weigh each hinge and multiply by the steel, stainless steel or brass supplier's figure, then add stamping, pin making, plating or polishing and assembly energy. Divide the plant's energy by hinges made.

ul: Mild steel, stainless steel or brass strip.

p: Report per hinge by size, material and weight.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per hinge (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 500,000 = 0.0426 kg CO2 per hinge
Add steel or brass for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
